scope: Operator-requested start of the real-G1 read-only phase. Connectivity probe only; no authentication prompt, remote command, SDK import, DDS reader, camera process, Publisher, mode change, or robot command.
requested_stage: subscriber-only full-29-joint, three-camera, DDS, and mock-sink Shadow preparation

probe.method: local TCP socket connect with 3 second hard timeout

decision.required_operator_action: Connect the Mac to the approved gateway/robot network path, verify a local route appropriate for the gateway, and confirm the robot remains in Damping with mechanical support and E-stop ready; then repeat the connectivity-only preflight.
